description: This PHP source file generates the web interface page for configuring wireless network settings on a network gateway device, including managing Wi-Fi radios, SSIDs, security settings, channels, WPS, band steering, mesh mode, and more. It includes server-side code to fetch current configuration data and client-side JavaScript for dynamic UI interactions and AJAX-based configuration updates.

classes.name: WirelessNetworkConfigPage
classes.description: Contains the server-side logic and structure for the wireless network configuration web page.

methods.name: generateWirelessConfigPage
methods.description: Generates the HTML and JavaScript content for the wireless configuration page.
